name: wechat
description: WeChat has no officially published MCP server; Tencent opened the iLink / ClawBot personal Bot protocol (ilinkai.weixin.qq.com) in 2026. This example uses the community wrapper wechat-mcp built on that protocol (static Go binary, standard library only, MIT, stdio): scan a QR code to bind, then send and receive messages.

metadata.install: git clone https://github.com/JingxuanC/wechat-mcp && cd wechat-mcp && make build
metadata.start: ./bin/wechat-mcp (QR page defaults to http://127.0.0.1:9765; --web off disables it)
metadata.env_hint: WECHAT_MCP_STATE (optional; overrides the state file path, default $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/wechat-mcp/state.json)
